title: pi.decisions.response.v1
description: Sidecar -> backend normalized response, per docs/PI/pi_jev_implementierungsplan_de.md section 3.3. Provider JSON is untrusted input; decisionsService.ts must reject anything that does not already satisfy this shape (unknown candidate_id, non-finite/out-of-range probabilities) before this object is ever constructed.

model_reported.description: Version the provider actually reported, if any; null (not the requested alias) when absent.

probabilities.description: candidate_id -> raw probability as reported by the provider. Every value must be finite and in [0,1]; a response containing NaN/Infinity anywhere is rejected wholesale, not clamped.

provider_confidence.description: The provider's own derived statistic (concentration of probabilities), forwarded under its own name. Never a decision gate; M5 must calibrate its own thresholds.

noul_answers.description: Independent scenario/noul-question answers, only meaningful when evidence for them exists (pi_jev_decisions_plan_de.md section 3).

error_code.description: Present when status != ok; stable application code, never a raw provider string. unavailable: mode_off, no_api_key, auth_failed, rate_limited, provider_error, network_error, timeout, aborted, busy, http_<n>. invalid_response: invalid_json, response_too_large, provider_rejected_request, response_not_object, model_missing, model_version_mismatch, answers_missing, answer_missing, unexpected_answer, unexpected_field, answer_type, unknown_candidate, probabilities_missing, non_finite_probability, non_finite_confidence, usage_missing, usage_invalid, generation_id_invalid, provider_invalid.

cost.description: USD billed by OpenRouter for this call.
